replacements.note: Each card was matched to exactly one TCGplayer product by set, collector number and name; that product prices holofoil and no non-holo printing, and an independent signal agrees (basis). A stratified 50-card sample, and 15 of the cards from sets without a TCGplayer link, were checked against card images where TCGdex has them. Products with stamp or distribution qualifiers and Gym Badge promos were held back. Evidence: https://www.tcgplayer.com/product/<tcgplayerProductID>/ and PokemonTCG/pokemon-tcg-data. Japanese Sun & Moon enhanced subsets (SM1+, SM2+, SM4+, SM5+) print every card in Mirror Holofoil (Bulbapedia set pages); their rows rely on that set fact as the independent signal. Japanese high-class packs (SM8b, SM12a, S8b, S12a, SV4a) reprint earlier cards; a card moves to Holo only when TCGdex lists an identical earlier Japanese printing (same name, HP, attacks and text) as a holo-only Rare, which is the independent signal.
